summary.headline: Palchus and Byzantine Astrology
summary.text: Table of contents for Palchus’s apotelesmatic book, the Chaldean Dodecaeteris, and Byzantine apotelesmatic collections, listing chapters on zodiacal signs, inceptions, war, decumbitures, fixed stars, lunar applications, and related topics. It also begins excerpts from Codex 7 (Vatic. 212), including Theophilus of Edessa’s preface and work on martial inceptions, expeditions, and tyranny.
